blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Age-related macular degeneration (AMD) is a leading cause of irreversible vision loss in older adults. While chronological age is a primary risk factor, it inadequately reflects individual variations in retinal aging, limiting effective AMD risk stratification and timely intervention. Here, we propose and validate fundus-based AMD age (FAA), which quantifies disease-specific retinal aging in AMD and captures accelerated AMD-related retinal aging, thereby improving prognostic precision over chronological age. Trained on 36,782 images from 2,192 participants in the Age-Related Eye Disease Study (AREDS) dataset and validated across AREDS and AREDS2 cohorts, our model demonstrates significant improvements over traditional chronological age-based approaches. Specifically, integrating the proposed FAA into Cox proportional-hazards models significantly enhances prediction performance. FAA improved the C-index from 0.836 to 0.888 and reduced the 5-year Brier score from 0.050 to 0.046 in AREDS, with consistent gains observed in AREDS2 (C-index 0.715 to 0.756; 2-year Brier 0.078 to 0.076). FAA showed improved prognostic performance across the two datasets and under different phenotype definitions (reading center-defined vs. specialist-defined grading), supporting its potential utility for AMD risk stratification. These findings highlight the advantage of incorporating FAA into AMD risk prediction frameworks, supporting further evaluation of FAA for AMD risk stratification.
blocks.zh: 与年龄有关的乳腺退化(AMD)是导致老年人视力丧失不可逆转的主要原因。 虽然年龄是主要风险因素,但它没有充分反映视网膜老化过程中的个别变化,限制了有效的AMD风险分层和及时干预。 在这里,我们提出并验证基于基金(FAA)的AMD年龄(FAA),它将AMD中特定疾病视网膜衰老量化,并捕捉加速AMD相关视网膜衰老,从而在时间跨度上提高预测精度. 在年龄相关眼病研究数据集的2 192名参与者的36 782幅图像上进行了培训,并在区域疾病相关眼病研究和区域疾病相关眼病研究2组中进行了验证。 具体地说,将拟议的FAA纳入Cox比例危险模型可大大提高预测性能. FAA将C指数从0.836改进为0.888,并将AREDS的5年布赖尔得分从0.050降至0.046,AREDS2(C-index 0.715降至0.756;2年布赖尔0.078降至0.076)观测到一致的增益. FAA显示,在两个数据集之间以及不同的苯型定义(读取中心定义与专家定义的分级)下,预测性能有所改善,支持其对AMD风险分级的潜在用途. 这些调查结果突出表明了将非洲金融分析法纳入AMD风险预测框架的优势,支持对AMD风险分层法的进一步评价。

blocks.en: 1.  Introduction
blocks.zh: 1. 联合国 导言

blocks.en: Age-related macular degeneration (AMD) is one of the leading causes of irreversible vision impairment and blindness among elderly individuals worldwide, with late-stage AMD dramatically impacting quality of life due to central vision loss [ 1 , 2 , 3 , 4 ] . The progression to late AMD significantly reduces visual function, independence, and overall well-being, underscoring the urgent need for early detection and timely intervention [ 5 , 6 , 7 , 8 , 9 ] .
blocks.zh: 与年龄有关的乳腺退化(AMD)是全世界老年人中不可逆视力受损和失明的主要原因之一,由于中央视力丧失[1,2,3,4],晚期AMD严重影响了生活质量. 向晚期AMD的发展大大降低了视觉功能、独立性和总体福祉,突出表明迫切需要及早发现和及时干预[5、6、7、8、9]。

blocks.en: Historically, chronological age, defined as the amount of time that has passed since a person’s birth, has played a central role in guiding clinical decisions related to prevention, screening, and intervention. In the context of AMD progression, chronological age is also widely recognized as an important risk factor for predicting AMD, as it is closely associated with the structural and functional decline of the eye. Additionally, clinicians utilize imaging biomarkers from color fundus photography (CFP) [ 10 ] and combine them with demographic information, such as age, for diagnosis and prognosis [ 9 , 10 , 11 , 12 ] . However, the current state-of-the-art AMD risk calculator, which relies on chronological age, presents limitations [ 9 , 13 , 14 ] . There is substantial interindividual variation in AMD progression among individuals of the same chronological age, suggesting that chronological age does not fully capture retinal characteristics associated with AMD progression [ 15 , 16 ] . This discrepancy motivates the development of an AMD-related retinal age that can complement chronological age in prognostic modeling, offer greater prognostic precision, and help tailor early interventions to effectively prevent or delay progression to the late stage of AMD.
blocks.zh: 从历史上看,年龄的定义是出生后的时间跨度,在指导与预防、筛查和干预有关的临床决定方面发挥了中心作用。 在AMD进取的背景下,时间年龄也被广泛认为是预测AMD的重要风险因素,因为它与眼的结构与功能下降密切相关. 此外,临床医生利用彩色Fundus摄影的成像生物标记[10],并将其与年龄等人口信息相结合,用于诊断和预测[9、10、11、12]。 然而,目前最先进的AMD风险计算器依赖于时间年龄,它提出了限制[9,13,14]. 年龄相同的个人在AMD进取方面存在着很大的个体差异,这表明时间相同的年龄不能完全反映AMD进取相关的视网膜特征[15,16]. 这种差异促使人们发展出与AMD相关的视网膜年龄,这种年龄可以在预测模型的制作中补充时间年龄,提供更大的预测精确度,并帮助调整早期干预,以有效防止或延迟到AMD后期阶段.

blocks.en: Recently, deep learning methods have shown promise for estimating biological aging clocks using regression models trained on retinal images [ 17 , 18 , 19 ] . Typically, these approaches are developed using fundus images from healthy individuals and then use either the estimated biological age or the age gap (the difference between machine-learning-predicted age and chronological age) as biomarkers for disease risk prediction [ 17 , 20 , 21 , 22 ] . However, these approaches do not capture disease-specific image-based aging processes and may not fully capture disease-related retinal variation relevant to AMD progression, where retinal structure and progression dynamics differ substantially from healthy eyes.
blocks.zh: 最近,深层的学习方法显示,使用经过视网膜图像培训的回归模型估算生物老化时钟有希望[17、18、19]。 通常,制定这些方法时使用健康个体的Fundus图像,然后使用估计的生物年龄或年龄差距(机器学习预测的年龄和时间年龄之间的差别)作为疾病风险预测的生物标志[17、20、21、22]。 然而,这些方法没有捕捉到基于特定疾病图像的老化过程,可能无法完全捕捉到与AMD进取有关的与疾病有关的视网膜变化,因为视网膜结构和进取动力与健康的眼睛有很大差异。

blocks.en: Deep learning has also been applied directly to AMD prognosis from color fundus photographs. Prior models have predicted progression to late AMD using baseline CFPs, clinical or genetic covariates, survival-analysis frameworks, and longitudinal image sequences [ 23 , 24 , 25 , 26 , 27 ] . For example, a prior longitudinal CFP study used CNN–LSTM and CNN–Transformer models to capture sequential information from patients’ image histories and predict 2-year and 5-year risk of progression to late AMD [ 27 ] . These approaches demonstrate the prognostic value of retinal imaging, but they primarily produce direct image-to-risk estimation rather than an interpretable disease-specific aging biomarker that can be incorporated into conventional survival models. Therefore, it remains unclear whether fundus-derived retinal aging signals can improve AMD risk prediction beyond chronological age, retinal age gap, and conventional AMD severity grading.
blocks.zh: 深层学习也直接被应用到从彩色Fundus相片的AMD预后. 以前的模型利用基线CFP、临床或遗传共变物、生存分析框架和纵向图像序列[23、24、25、26、27]预测到晚期AMD。 例如,先前的纵向CFP研究使用CNN-LSTM和CNN-Transformer模型从患者图像史上获取相继信息并预测到AMD后期的两年和五年风险[27]. 这些方法显示了视网膜成像的预测价值,但它们主要产生直接的图像至风险估计,而不是可解释的疾病特定老化生物标记,可以纳入常规生存模型. 因此,目前还不清楚由基金衍生的视网膜老化信号是否能够改进超过时间年龄的AMD风险预测、视网膜年龄差距以及常规的AMD严重程度分级。

blocks.en: To address these gaps, we introduce F undus-based A MD A ge ( FAA ), an AI-derived disease-specific retinal aging biomarker that quantifies accelerated fundus aging associated with AMD progression. Unlike epigenetics-based clocks developed for general aging and mortality estimation, FAA captures AMD-related retinal aging signatures learned directly from CFP annotated with validated AMD severity scores. To our knowledge, this represents the first effort utilizing a fundus-derived age within survival analysis frameworks explicitly tailored to AMD prognosis. Moreover, our method offers greater interpretability than existing deep learning-based AMD prognosis models [ 23 , 24 , 25 , 26 , 27 ] , which typically predict risk from CFP in a black-box manner. By explicitly predicting fundus-based AMD age, our model enables a more accurate understanding and communication of individual risk estimates, which are crucial for clinical decision-making.
blocks.zh: 为了弥补这些差距,我们引入了基于F undus的AMD A ge(FAA),这是一个AI衍生出的特殊疾病视网膜老化生物标志,它将加速与AMD进步相关的基金老化量化. 与为一般衰老和死亡率估计而开发的基于遗传学的时钟不同,FAA捕捉直接从CFP中吸取的AMD相关视网膜衰老签名,并附有经过验证的AMD严重性分数. 据我们所知,这是首次努力,在生存分析框架内,明确针对AMD的预测,利用基金衍生年龄。 此外,我们的方法提供了比现有的基于深层学习的AMD预测模型[23,24,25,26,27]更大的可解释性,这些模型通常以黑盒方式预测来自CFP的风险. 通过明确预测基于资金的AMD时代,我们的模型能够更准确地理解和交流个人风险估计,这对于临床决策至关重要。

blocks.en: Our method was developed using two independent datasets from the Age-Related Eye Disease Studies (AREDS [ 28 ] and AREDS2 [ 29 ] ), collected by the National Eye Institute in the U.S., which have been extensively used in research on AMD prognosis. We trained the FAA estimation model on 36,782 retinal images from 2,192 participants in the AREDS. We then combined the FAA with biomarkers defined by either a human grader at the reading center or retinal specialists to construct Cox proportional hazards models for AMD progression. The prognostic models were evaluated using phenotype-specific eye-level samples. The reading-center-defined analyses included 769 eyes from the AREDS internal-test cohort and 5,651 eyes from AREDS2, whereas the specialist-defined analyses included 811 and 5,964 eyes, respectively.
blocks.zh: 我们的方法是利用美国国家眼科研究所收集的与年龄相关的眼病研究(AREDS [28]和AREDS 2 [29])的两个独立数据集开发的,这些数据被广泛用于AMD预后的研究. 我们培训了FAA关于36,782个视网膜图像的估算模型,这些图像来自2,192个AREDS参与者. 然后我们把FAA和生物标记结合起来 由读取中心的人类分级员 或视网膜专家 来构建 Cox 成比例的危害模型 预测模型使用苯基特异性眼层样本进行评估. 阅读中心定义的分析包括来自AREDS内部测试组的769只眼睛和来自AREDS2的5,651只眼睛,而专家定义的分析分别包括811只和5,964只眼睛。

The AREDS dataset comprises 45,818 fundus images from 2,740 participants. Dataset allocation was performed at the participant level, with both eyes and all longitudinal visits from the same participant retained within a single partition. After applying baseline endpoint, follow-up, and phenotype-availability criteria, the reading-center-defined Cox analyses included 3,799 development eyes and 769 internal-test eyes. These eyes were graded by certified human graders at the University of Wisconsin Reading Center (hereinafter referred to as the reading-center-defined setting ). To compare the performance of FAA with that of retinal specialists (investigators whose assessments had previously been recorded during AREDS), we also constructed a specialist-defined setting graded by retinal specialists at the qualifying visit, using a subset of 3,840 eyes from the training set and 811 eyes from the test set.

blocks.en: Figure 1 : Overview of the study workflow for predicting late AMD progression. a-b , Flowchart detailing participant selection, data preprocessing, and exclusion criteria for building the AMD risk prediction models based on the AREDS and AREDS2 datasets. c , The workflow for predicting late AMD progression. FAA, as predicted by the VMamba model [ 30 ] from CFP, is combined with smoking status and clinically relevant AMD phenotypes (e.g., drusen size and pigmentary abnormalities), and the resulting model is integrated into a Cox proportional hazards model to predict the risk of AMD progression.
blocks.zh: 图1:预测AMD后期进展的研究工作流程概览. a-b,Flowchart详细列出参与者选择、数据预处理以及基于AREDS和AREDS2数据集构建AMD风险预测模型的排除标准。 c. 预测AMD后期进展的工作流程。 如CFP的VMamba模型[30]所预测,FAA与吸烟状态和临床相关的AMD酚类(如德鲁森尺寸和色素异常等)结合,所形成的模型被整合为克克成比例危险模型来预测AMD进化的风险.

blocks.en: AREDS2 includes 26,215 fundus images from 4,192 participants and was used as the external testing set for this study. After phenotype-specific completeness criteria and prespecified participant-level exclusions were applied, the final external-validation samples included 5,651 eyes in the reading-center-defined analysis and 5,964 eyes in the specialist-defined analysis. No AREDS2 data were used for FAA training, Cox-model fitting, model selection, hyperparameter optimization, or threshold determination.

First, a VMamba model was adapted to estimate FAA [ 30 ] . The model was trained on all CFPs from the AREDS training set to ensure generalizability across the full spectrum of AMD severity (see described under FAA model development for training details). Second, a Cox proportional hazards model was used to predict the probability of progression to late AMD based on FAA. In this step, we added additional phenotypes to further enhance the model’s predictive performance.

blocks.en: 2.4.  Adjusted associations of FAA and chronological age with late-AMD progression
blocks.zh: 2.4. 经调整的联邦艾滋病协会和晚期AMD年龄

blocks.en: To examine the associations of FAA and chronological age with late-AMD progression after adjustment for established clinical covariates, we fitted two otherwise identically specified Cox proportional hazards models within each phenotype-definition setting. Both models were fitted using the same analytical eyes and included the same smoking and AMD phenotype covariates; the only difference was whether chronological age or FAA was included as the age-related predictor. Both age representations were modeled per 1-year increase.
blocks.zh: 为了检查FAA的关联和经过调整的临床同位素晚期AMD发展的时间年龄,我们在每个酚类定义设置中安装了另外两个相同规定的Cox比例危险模型。 这两种模型都采用了相同的分析眼睛,包括相同的吸烟和AMD的苯基共变;唯一的区别是时间年龄或FAA是否作为与年龄有关的预测物包括在内。 两种年龄代表都以每1年增加一次为模式。

blocks.en: These results indicate that FAA had a numerically larger per-year adjusted association with late-AMD progression than chronological age in otherwise matched models. However, because FAA and chronological age were evaluated in separately fitted models and FAA is a learned, disease-informed image representation, the coefficient magnitudes were not interpreted as a formal ranking of variable importance or as evidence that one FAA year is biologically equivalent to one calendar year. The comparative prognostic performance of the two age representations was instead evaluated using held-out C-index, time-dependent AUC, and Brier-score results, as reported in the held-out prognostic-performance analyses.
blocks.zh: 这些结果表明,在其他匹配的模型中,联邦航空局每年经调整后与AMD后期进展的联系比时间年龄大。 然而,由于FAA和时间跨度年龄被用单独安装的模型来评价,FAA是一种有知识的,基于疾病的图像表现,因此系数级没有被解释为具有可变重要性的正式排名,也没有被解释为一个FAA年在生物学上相当于一个日历年的证据. 如搁置预测-业绩分析所报告,对两个年龄表现的比较预测业绩进行了评估,采用了搁置C-指数、时间依赖的AUC和Brier-score结果。

blocks.en: Figure 4 : Multivariate Cox regression analyses adjusted for clinical covariates. a , Reading-center-defined Cox regression model using chronological age versus FAA. Covariates included geographic atrophy within the grid (GEOAWI), RPE depigmentation area within the grid (RPEDWI), increased pigment area within the grid (INCPWI), drusen area within the grid (DRARWI), and smoking status (SMK). b , Specialist-defined Cox regression model using chronological age versus FAA. Covariates included clinical drusen size assessment (DRUSENQ) and pigment abnormalities (PIGDRUQ), alongside smoking status. Each row represents the coefficient and its corresponding 95% confidence interval. Hazard ratios correspond to a one-unit increase in each covariate (1 year for FAA and chronological age, and one-grade increase for ordinal phenotype variables).
blocks.zh: 图4:多变量 Cox回归分析根据临床共变量调整. a, 读取中心定义 Cox回归模型使用时间顺序年龄对FAA. 相变物包括网格内的地理萎缩(GEOAWI),网格内的REPE去皮化区(RPEDWI),网格内的色素增加区(INCPWI),网格内的德鲁森区(DRARWI)和吸烟状态(SMK). b. 专家定义 Cox回归模型使用时间顺序年龄对FAA. 共变物包括临床德鲁森体积评估(DRUSENQ)和色素异常(PIGDRUQ)以及吸烟状态. 每行代表系数及其相应的95%的置信间隔. 危害比率对应每个同分变量的一单位增加值(FAA和时间年龄分别为一岁和一等增加值,而正数类变数则为一等增加值)。

blocks.en: Figure 5 : Kaplan-Meier survival curves comparing the prognostic performance of Cox proportional hazards models in predicting overall AMD progression (from early stages to late AMD) using chronological age and FAA. a-b , Reading-center-defined Cox models using chronological age and FAA. c-d , Specialist-defined Cox models using chronological age and FAA. High- and low-predicted-risk groups were defined using the model-specific median predicted risk in the AREDS development cohort. The fixed thresholds were applied unchanged to the AREDS internal-test cohort.
blocks.zh: 图5:卡普兰-迈尔存活曲线在预测总体AMD进展(从早期到AMD后期)时,利用时间年龄和FAA来比较克克克成比例危险模型的预测性能. a-b, 读取中心定义 Cox模型使用时间年龄和FAA. c-d,专家定义 Cox模型使用时间年龄和FAA. 高和低预测风险群体的定义是使用AREDS开发组中特定模型的预测风险中位数。 对AREDS内部测试组群适用了固定阈值。

These findings indicate that combining FAA and risk factors can more effectively identify eligible eyes at substantially increased risk of AMD progression.

(单位:千美元) Cox模型跨越三个临床相关的分组:70 \ geq 70岁参与者的合格眼睛,FAA 10 \ geq 10岁年龄差距的参与者的合格眼睛,以及吸烟史参与者的合格眼睛. 对于每个分组,截断被定义为符合同一分组标准的发展中眼睛的预测风险中位数,并适用于相应的内部测试分组。 这些调查结果表明,结合航空和航天局和风险因素,可以更有效地识别合格眼睛,从而大大增加AMD发展的风险。

blocks.en: Figure 6 : Kaplan–Meier survival analyses combine FAA with other clinical risk factors. a-c , Reading-center-defined Cox models in (a) Eligible eyes from participants aged ≥ 70 \geq 70 years, (b) Eligible eyes from participants with a fundus-based AMD age gap of ≥ 10 \geq 10 years, and (c) Eligible eyes from participants with a smoking history. d-f , Specialist-defined Cox models in (d) Eligible eyes from participants aged ≥ 70 \geq 70 years, (e) Eligible eyes from participants with a fundus-based AMD age gap of ≥ 10 \geq 10 years, and (f) Eligible eyes from participants with a smoking history. Across all subgroups, integrating FAA into the Cox model identifies high-risk eyes, underscoring the added prognostic value of combining FAA with other clinical factors.
blocks.zh: 图6:卡普兰-迈尔存活分析结合了FAA和其他临床风险因素. a-c,读取中心定义 (a) 70岁70岁参与者的合格眼睛;(b) 年龄差距为10岁10岁、以基金为基础的参与者的合格眼睛;以及(c) 吸烟史参与者的合格眼睛。 d-f,专家定义 (d) 70岁70岁参与者的合格眼睛;(e) 年龄差距为10岁10岁、以基金为基础的参与者的合格眼睛;(f) 有吸烟历史的参与者的合格眼睛。 在所有分组中,将FAA纳入Cox模型可以识别出高风险的眼睛,强调FAA与其他临床因素结合的附加预测价值.

blocks.en: Figure 7 : Characterization of FAA in relation to chronological age and AMD severity. a , Relationship between chronological age and fundus-based AMD age (FAA) in the testing cohort. Each point represents one eligible eye and is colored according to baseline AMD stage. The dashed diagonal line represents perfect agreement between FAA and chronological age, and the solid line shows the fitted linear trend. b , Mean squared error (MSE) and root mean squared error (RMSE) of FAA relative to chronological age across baseline AMD stages. c , Distribution of FAA across no AMD, early AMD, intermediate AMD, and late AMD stages. d , Distribution of chronological age across no AMD, early AMD, intermediate AMD, and late AMD stages. The stage-wise distribution of FAA is consistent with the severity-guided ranking objective.

Higher FAA was consistently associated with increased risk of late AMD progression, with the strongest effect observed in early and intermediate stages. In the early AMD stage, the high-FAA group showed significantly reduced progression-free survival (HR = 13.19, 95% CI 3.16–55.05, p < 0.001 p<0.001 ), and a similar pattern was observed in the intermediate AMD stage (HR = 2.17, 95% CI 1.39–4.03, p = 0.010 p=0.010 ). No significant separation was observed in the no-AMD stage ( p = 1.0 p=1.0 ), likely due to low event rates in this subgroup. Collectively, these results demonstrate that FAA alone provides effective risk stratification among the eyes identified as having early or intermediate AMD.

blocks.en: 2.8.  Illustrative Case Analysis
blocks.zh: 2.8. 说明性案例分析

blocks.en: To further demonstrate the practical value and clinical interpretability of our AMD risk prediction framework, we provide illustrative examples that include color fundus photographs, corresponding AMD severity scores, chronological ages, FAA, and normalized model-specific risk scores derived from both reading-center-defined and specialist-defined Cox models. We additionally incorporate FullGrad visualizations [ 31 ] , which highlight retinal regions that contribute to the FAA estimation. These maps reveal that the FAA focuses on physiologically meaningful structures, such as the macular region, drusen-related abnormalities, and pigmentary changes, confirming that the highlighted regions are consistent with regions known to be affected in AMD, particularly the macular area, and supporting the model’s interpretability. blocks.en: 3.  Discussion
blocks.zh: 3个 讨论情况

blocks.en: Our study introduces an approach to predict AMD progression risk by integrating fundus-based AMD age (FAA) with established AMD phenotypes. We found that our late AMD progression prediction model, which incorporates FAA into Cox proportional hazards models, significantly improved the predictive accuracy for AMD progression compared to models using chronological age alone. FAA outperforms chronological age because it integrates fundus-derived retinal features and detailed phenotypic annotations, thereby providing a more comprehensive and precise indicator of retinal health status. Unlike chronological age, which is a general measure of aging, FAA effectively captures individualized differences in retinal pathology and functional deterioration associated with AMD. Notably, this study validated the effectiveness of the proposed FAA-based prediction model across two large, multicenter datasets (AREDS and AREDS2), demonstrating its generalizability and clinical applicability. Our findings emphasize that the FAA provides a more accurate reflection of the underlying retinal aging processes relevant to AMD, thus enhancing risk assessment and clinical decision-making. Moreover, the consistent performance improvements observed across different phenotype definitions further underscore the applicability and reliability of FAA as a prognostic biomarker for AMD.
blocks.zh: 我们的研究采用了一种方法,通过将基于基金的AMD年龄(FAA)与既定的AMDpheno类型相结合来预测AMD发展风险. 我们发现,我们晚期的AMD进展预测模型将FAA纳入Cox比例危险模型中,与仅使用时间跨度的模型相比,AMD进展的预测精度大大提高了. FAA的成绩超过了时间年龄,因为它综合了由Fundus衍生的视网膜特征和详细的视网膜说明,从而为视网膜健康状况提供了更全面和更准确的指标. 与时间跨度年龄(英语:Constitutional age)是老年的一般衡量标准不同,FAA有效地捕捉了视网膜病理方面的个性化差异和与AMD相关的功能恶化. 值得注意的是,这项研究验证了拟议的基于FAA的预测模型在两个大型多中心数据集(AREDS和AREDS2)上的有效性,表明其可通用性和临床适用性。 我们的调查结果强调,联邦航空局更准确地反映了与AMD有关的基本视网膜衰老过程,从而加强了风险评估和临床决策。 此外,不同酚类定义中观察到的一致性能改进进一步突出了FAA作为AMD的预测生物标志的适用性和可靠性.

blocks.en: From a clinical perspective, FAA offers a practical and interpretable biomarker that could assist ophthalmologists in risk stratification, follow-up scheduling, and early intervention planning. By providing a reasonable “retinal age”, the FAA enables clearer communication of disease risk to patients and supports more personalized management strategies. Clinicians can use FAA to more accurately estimate each patient’s likelihood of progressing to late AMD, thereby identifying individuals who may require closer monitoring or proactive treatment. blocks.en: Although the concept of biological aging has long been acknowledged, there has been a recent surge in public and scientific interest in its clinical implications. It is now widely recognized that healthcare decisions should not be based solely on chronological age; instead, there is increasing consensus that they should also consider the cumulative physiological and psychological effects. While cellular and molecular “frailomics” measures have been widely explored as indicators of biological aging, imaging biomarkers have received comparatively little attention for their potential in this domain. In this study, we hypothesized that features derived from color fundus photographs could provide a macroscopic representation of age-related and AMD-related retinal variation. Across analyses using phenotypes graded by the Reading Center or assessed by retinal specialists, Cox models incorporating FAA showed better prognostic performance than the corresponding models using chronological age. These findings support further investigation of disease-specific retinal age representations for AMD risk stratification. Prospective validation and clinically defined decision thresholds will be needed before such measures can be used to identify intervention windows or guide preventive management.
blocks.zh: 虽然生物老化的概念早已被承认,但最近公众对其临床影响的兴趣和科学兴趣激增. 现在人们普遍认识到,保健决定不应完全基于年龄;相反,人们越来越一致地认为,它们还应考虑累积的生理和心理影响。 虽然作为生物老化的指标,对细胞和分子“分泌物”措施进行了广泛探讨,但成像生物标记在这方面的潜力相对较少受到重视。 在这项研究中,我们假设从彩色Fundus相片中得出的特征可以提供与年龄和AMD相关的视网膜变化的宏观表现。 采用阅读中心分级或视网膜专家评估的酚类分析,采用FAA的Cox模型的预测性能比使用时间年龄的相应模型要好。 这些调查结果有助于进一步调查针对疾病视网膜年龄对AMD风险分层的描述。 在使用此类措施确定干预窗口或指导预防管理之前,需要进行前瞻性验证和临床确定的决定阈值。

blocks.en: Previous studies have frequently evaluated the difference between image-predicted age and chronological age as a standalone biomarker. In this study, FAA age gap (defined as FAA minus chronological age) had distinct roles in model development and secondary analyses. During FAA development, it was calculated from the network output and chronological age and used in the severity-guided ranking objective. The age gap itself does not contain intrinsic age information and is, therefore, insufficient as a direct replacement for FAA. blocks.en: Moreover, our study leveraged two sets of phenotypes–specialist-defined and reading-center-defined. Retinal specialist-defined phenotypes derived from routine diagnostic procedures without specialized equipment tend to be less precise than those provided by human graders at the reading center. Consequently, our models demonstrated slightly lower prognostic performance when using specialist-defined phenotypes than when using reading-center-defined phenotypes. Nonetheless, the model maintained strong predictive capabilities in both scenarios, affirming the robustness and practical applicability of our proposed methodology regardless of the source of phenotype definition.
blocks.zh: 此外,我们的研究还利用了两套由专家定义的和由阅读中心定义的酚类。 没有专门设备的常规诊断程序产生的视网膜专家定义的酚类往往不如阅读中心的人类分级人员提供的精确. 因此,我们的模型在使用专家定义的苯基时显示的预测性能略低于使用读心定义的苯基时。 尽管如此,该模型在两种情景中都保持了强大的预测能力,证实了我们拟议方法的稳健性和实际适用性,而不论该方法的定义来源如何。

However, this approach requires access to compatible phenotype annotations, which may not always be available in other datasets. The FAA estimator, which uses CFPs alone at inference, was applied to AREDS2 without retraining. In this related external clinical-trial cohort, the FAA-based models retained higher discrimination than the corresponding chronological-age-based models, supporting further cross-cohort evaluation of the FAA representation. In addition, FAA values used for Cox-model development were obtained by averaging predictions from all five models, which may have introduced optimistic bias during Cox-model fitting. Nevertheless, no participant from the AREDS internal-test or AREDS2 cohort was included in FAA training or validation, and all reported held-out performance metrics were evaluated in participants whose complete image histories were unseen by the FAA models. Future studies should use participant-level cross-fitting or nested model-development procedures when generating FAA values for downstream survival-model fitting.

blocks.en: Second, our study did not separately analyze the two distinct subtypes of late AMD, namely geographic atrophy and neovascular AMD. This decision reflects our primary aim of stratifying risk and guiding early interventions for individuals with no, early, or intermediate AMD. Therefore, individuals who had already progressed to late-stage AMD at the baseline visit were outside the scope of our work. Future studies may benefit from exploring subtype-specific prognostic markers to further refine risk prediction and tailor management strategies.
blocks.zh: 第二,我们的研究没有单独分析晚期AMD的两个不同的子类型,即地理学萎缩和新血管AMD. 这一决定反映了我们的首要目标是为没有、早有或中期AMD的个人确定风险和指导早期干预。 因此,在基线访问中已经进入后期AMD的个人不属于我们的工作范围。 未来的研究可能得益于探索特定亚类型的预测标记来进一步完善风险预测并调整管理战略.

blocks.en: Fourth, both AREDS and AREDS2 were U.S.-based clinical-trial cohorts composed predominantly of White participants. Consequently, external validation in AREDS2 does not establish transportability across racial and ethnic groups, geographic regions, or routine-care settings. Population differences in retinal characteristics, AMD risk profiles, and healthcare contexts may affect model performance. Future studies should evaluate FAA in racially, ethnically, and geographically diverse cohorts and determine whether population-specific recalibration is required before broader clinical implementation.
blocks.zh: 第四,AREDS和AREDS2都是以美国为基地的临床试验组群,主要由白人参与者组成. 因此,AREDS2中的外部验证无法确定跨种族和族裔群体、地理区域或常规照料环境的可运输性。 视网膜特征、AMD风险简介和医疗保健方面的人口差异可能影响模型性能。 今后的研究应评估不同种族、族裔和地域群体的FAA,并确定是否需要在更广泛的临床实施之前进行针对具体人口的再调整。

blocks.en: In addition, FAA has not yet been validated against external biological aging benchmarks, such as molecular aging markers, systemic frailty indices, or multimodal imaging biomarkers. Because such measurements are not available in AREDS/AREDS2, our analysis is limited to retinal aging signals. Future studies incorporating molecular or multimodal aging assessments will be important for further validating the biological relevance and interpretability of FAA.
blocks.zh: 此外,FAA尚未根据外部生物老化基准进行验证,如分子老化标记、系统脆弱指数或多模式成像生物标记等。 由于AREDS/AREDS2中没有这种测量,我们的分析仅限于视网膜老化信号。 纳入分子或多模式老化评估的未来研究对于进一步验证FAA的生物学相关性和可解释性十分重要。

blocks.en: In summary, we have demonstrated that incorporating retinal-based FAA into AMD risk prediction models significantly enhances predictive accuracy and clinical relevance compared to traditional models that rely solely on chronological age. Despite inherent limitations, such as differences in phenotypic definitions across datasets and the lack of subtype-specific analysis for late-stage AMD, our approach showed reproducible prognostic improvements across the two study cohorts and warrants further evaluation for potential clinical application. Future research addressing these limitations and validating the FAA in diverse populations could further solidify its role as a pivotal biomarker in the management and prognosis of AMD.
blocks.zh: 总之,我们已经表明,将视网膜FAA纳入AMD风险预测模型,与完全依赖时间年龄的传统模型相比,大大提高了预测准确性和临床相关性。 尽管存在固有的局限性,例如不同数据集的间皮定义不同,以及缺乏对晚期AMD的分类型具体分析,但我们的做法显示出两个研究组的可再生的预测性改进,需要进一步评价潜在的临床应用。 今后针对这些局限性的研究和在不同的人群中验证《联邦渔业协定》可以进一步巩固其作为管理和预测AMD的关键生物标志的作用。

blocks.en: The AREDS cohort comprised 2,740 participants and was initially divided into a development cohort of 2,192 participants and an internal test cohort of 548 participants. The 2,192 AREDS development participants were partitioned into five mutually exclusive folds at the participant level. Five FAA models were trained, each using four folds for training and the remaining fold for validation. All images from both eyes and all longitudinal visits of a participant were retained within the same fold. Subsequently, the predicted FundusAge was combined with AMD phenotypes to develop a prognostic Cox proportional hazards model [ 35 ] for predicting AMD progression. Of the 548 participants assigned to the internal-test cohort, 449 contributed baseline eye records to the baseline analytical dataset, yielding 898 baseline eye records before endpoint- and phenotype-specific eligibility criteria were applied. After applying the eligibility criteria, the final Cox analytical samples included 3,799 development eyes and 769 internal-test eyes for the reading-center-defined endpoints, and 3,840 development eyes and 811 internal-test eyes for the specialist-defined endpoints. All dataset partitioning was performed at the participant level using unique participant identifiers. Images from both eyes, repeated acquisitions, and all longitudinal visits of the same participant were retained within the same partition.

blocks.en: 4.2.  Phenotype, outcome, and censoring definitions
blocks.zh: 4.2. 现象类型、结果和审查定义

blocks.en: Two separate Cox proportional hazards models were built using different sets of AMD phenotypes in the AREDS dataset. One set of phenotypes was defined by expert image graders in the reading center, including geographic atrophy (GEOAWI), retinal pigment epithelium depigmentation (RPEDWI), increased pigment (INCPWI), and drusen area (DRARWI), each scored within the central grid on a 0-7 scale. The other set was defined by retinal specialists in clinical practice and consisted of clinical drusen size assessment (DRUSENQ, 0-3) and pigment abnormalities (PIGDRUQ, yes/no). This design allowed us to validate the predictive value of FAA under distinct phenotype annotation standards.
blocks.zh: 两个分开 Cox比例危险模型是在AREDS数据集中使用不同的AMD酚型来构建的. 阅读中心的专家图像分级员界定了一组苯基,包括地缘萎缩(GEOAWI),视网膜色素上皮脱落(RPEDWI),增色(INCPWI)和德鲁森区(DRARWI),每组都以0至7个尺度在中央网格内得分. 另一套由临床实践的视网膜专家定义,由临床德鲁森体积评估(DRUSENQ,0-3)和色素异常(PIGDRUQ,是/否)组成. 这个设计使我们得以验证FAA的预测值,在鲜明的酚型注释标准下.

blocks.en: Phenotype harmonization was performed specifically for the AREDS2 external-validation analysis. The primary AREDS internal-test Cox models were fitted and evaluated using the native AREDS phenotype coding. For external validation, corresponding variables were mapped to common, variable-specific numerical scales. AREDS RPEDWI and INCPWI were coarsened from their native 0–7 scales to 0–4 and 0–3, respectively, to match the grading resolution of AREDS2 DPINGRID and IPINGRID. Conversely, the continuous AREDS2 GADAGRID variable was discretized according to the native 0–7 AREDS GEOAWI thresholds. Variables that already shared compatible coding were retained without transformation. The corresponding harmonized Cox models were fitted using only the AREDS development cohort and subsequently applied to AREDS2 without model fitting, recalibration, or outcome-based tuning in AREDS2. blocks.en: All covariates included in the Cox proportional hazards models were defined at baseline. Continuous variables, including fundus-based AMD age (FAA) and chronological age, were modeled per 1-year increase. AMD phenotype variables (e.g., GEOAWI, RPEDWI, and INCPWI) were treated as ordinal variables and entered the Cox model as continuous scores based on their grading scales. Hazard ratios for these variables, therefore, correspond to a one-grade increase in the respective phenotype score. Categorical variables, including smoking status, were encoded using indicator (dummy) variables, with “never smoker” as the reference category. No continuous interpretation or unit was assigned to categorical variables. blocks.en: The AREDS data used in this study contained an eye-specific 12-level severity coding derived from the AREDS detailed severity system. Levels 1–9 represented ordered non-late AMD severity, whereas levels 10–12 represented late-AMD categories. For descriptive reporting and stage-stratified analyses, we grouped these labels as no AMD (score 1), early AMD (scores 2–5), intermediate AMD (scores 6–9), and late AMD (scores 10–12). This four-category grouping was not used to train the FAA estimation model or fit the primary Cox models.
blocks.zh: 本研究中使用的AREDS数据包含一个从AREDS详细严重性系统中衍生出的眼睛特异性12级重度编码. 第1至9级为命令的非晚期AMD严重性,第10至12级为晚期AMD类别。 关于描述性报告和分阶段分析,我们将这些标签归类为没有AMD(分数1)、早期AMD(分数2-5)、中间AMD(分数6-9)和后期AMD(分数10-12)。 这种四类组别不用于训练FAA估计模型或与主克克模型相适应.

blocks.en: Progression to late AMD was defined at the eye level. Eyes with an original AREDS severity score of 10–12 at baseline were excluded from survival modeling because they had already reached the study endpoint. For each eligible eye with a baseline severity score of 1–9, follow-up time was measured from the baseline visit to the first follow-up visit at which that eye reached a late-AMD severity category, defined as an original AREDS severity score of 10–12. Eyes that developed late AMD during follow-up were coded as events. Eyes without observed progression were right-censored at their last available gradable ophthalmic visit. Thus, the follow-up time represented either the time from baseline to the first observed late-AMD event or, for a censored eye, the time from baseline to its last available gradable follow-up examination.
blocks.zh: 进取到AMD后期的定义是在眼平面. 最初AREDS严重性得分为基线10-12的眼被排除于生存模型之外,因为它们已经到达研究终点。 对基线严重程度得分为1至9的每个合格眼睛,从基线访问到第一次后续访问,对后续时间进行了衡量。 在后续访问中,该眼睛达到AMD后期严重程度类别,即最初的AREDS重度得分为10至12。 在后续过程中发展出后期AMD的眼睛被编码为事件. 在最后一次可分级的眼科检查中,没有观察到进展的双眼受到正确的检查。 因此,后续时间要么是从基线到首次观测到的AMD后期事件的时间,要么是经过审查的眼界,即从基线到其最后可用的可分级后续审查的时间。

blocks.en: Mortality was not available as a separately adjudicated competing event in the analytical dataset, and the reason for the termination of follow-up was not separately modeled. Death was therefore not treated as a competing event using a cause-specific or distribution hazard model. Eyes without an observed late-AMD event were right-censored at their last available gradable ophthalmic visit, and the survival analyses relied on the standard independent-censoring assumption. Consequently, potentially informative censoring associated with death, withdrawal, or loss to follow-up could not be excluded.
blocks.zh: 死亡率并不是作为分析数据集中单独裁定的相竞事件提供的,终止后续行动的原因也不是单独模拟的。 因此,使用特定原因或分布危险模型的死亡不被视为相互竞争的事件。 没有观测到的晚期AMD事件的眼睛在他们最后一次可用的可分级眼科访问时被正确检查,而生存分析依赖于标准的独立审查假设. 因此,不能排除与死亡、退出或后续行动损失有关的潜在信息审查。

blocks.en: Missing data were handled using complete-case analysis separately within each phenotype-definition setting. Eyes missing follow-up time, event status, FAA, chronological age, smoking status, or any phenotype required for the corresponding Cox model were excluded. No statistical imputation was performed. Within each phenotype-definition setting, the FAA-based model, chronological-age-based model, and corresponding comparison models were fitted and evaluated using the same complete-case analytical sample.
blocks.zh: 处理缺失的数据时,在每种酚种定义的设定中分别使用完整的个案分析。 失眼后续时间,事件状态,FAA,时间年龄,吸烟状态,或对应Cox模型所需的任何苯基. 未进行统计估算。 在每一种苯基定义设置中,都采用了基于FAA的模型,以时间顺序为基础的模型,以及相应的比较模型,并使用同样的完整案例分析样本进行了相接和评价.

Traditionally, a Cox proportional hazards model is constructed using chronological age, smoking status, and relevant AMD phenotypes defined by specialists or experts to predict AMD progression risk. In contrast, our proposed method replaces chronological age with a deep-learning-estimated FAA derived directly from CFPs. Specifically, we first trained the FAA estimation model using the entire set of available images from the training cohort (2,192 participants, 36,782 images). Subsequently, for training and testing the Cox model, we used only images from each participant’s baseline visit. We also excluded cases already identified with late AMD (AMD severity score ≥ 10 \geq 10 ), as such cases are clinically considered to have already reached the progression endpoint. The proposed pipeline ensures accurate evaluation of the FAA’s role in predicting AMD progression among patients with normal, early, and intermediate stages of AMD, enabling better patient risk stratification and clinical management.

blocks.en: For each image, the FAA age gap g i g_{i} was defined as: g i = a ^ i − a i , g_{i}={\hat{a}}_{i}-a_{i}, (2) where a ^ i {\hat{a}}_{i} is FAA and a i a_{i} is chronological age. We developed the FAA estimation model to improve prediction robustness compared to traditional convolutional neural network (CNN) methods. Unlike standard CNN architectures, the VMamba backbone is uniquely suited to effectively capture both local and long-range spatial information in retinal fundus images. By capturing long-range spatial dependencies through a state-space architecture, our VMamba-based network adaptively focuses on subtle but clinically meaningful features, such as minor microvascular alterations and small-scale drusen formations, which might be overlooked by conventional CNN approaches. This facilitates comprehensive feature extraction, enabling more accurate estimation of FAA across various stages of AMD.

blocks.en: Besides, we introduced a ranking-based loss function to explicitly guide the model in capturing age increments associated with increasing AMD severity. Specifically, for any two images ( i , j ) (i,j) within a training batch, with corresponding chronological ages ( a i , a j ) (a_{i},a_{j}) , predicted AMD age ( a ^ i , a ^ j ) ({\hat{a}}_{i},{\hat{a}}_{j}) , and ranking label ( s i , s j ) (s_{i},s_{j}) , we apply a pairwise ranking constraint to encourage the model to capture progressive AMD-related aging patterns across disease stages. Specifically, for any two samples i i and j j , if i i has more severe AMD than j j\ ( s i > s j s_{i}>s_{j} ), we require g i > g j g_{i}>g_{j} , so that the relative ordering of FAA reflects disease severity. Inspired by the formulation of the Cox proportional hazards loss (CoxPH), we defined our ranking loss as: L r ​ a ​ n ​ k ( a ^ , a , s ) = − 1 | B | ∑ i = 1 B ( g i − log ∑ s i > s j j exp g j ) . L_{rank}\left(\hat{a},a,s\right)=-\frac{1}{|B|}\sum_{i=1}^{B}\left(g_{i}-\log\sum_{s_{i}>s_{j}}^{j}{\exp g_{j}}\right). (5)

blocks.en: The FAA model used VMamba-small-s2l15 as the image backbone. The network was initialized from the ImageNet pretrained checkpoint. The original classification head was replaced by a linear layer producing one continuous FAA estimate. All backbone parameters and the newly initialized output head were fine-tuned end-to-end. Training used the Adam optimizer with a learning rate of 1 × 10 − 4 1\times 10^{-4} , a batch size of 96, and 100 epochs. Random seeds for Python, NumPy, and PyTorch were set to 42. Training was implemented in PyTorch 2.6.0 and performed on an NVIDIA A100 GPU with 80 GB of memory.
blocks.zh: FAA模型使用VMamba-small-s2l15作为图像主干. 该网络从ImageNet预先训练的检查站起步。 最初的分类头被一个线性地层所取代,产生一个连续的FAA估计. 所有主干参数和新初始化的产出头被微调出端到端. 训练使用亚当优化器,学习率为1×10−4 1\times 10×4},批量大小为96个,有100个时代. Python,NumPy和PyTorch的随机种子被设定为42个. 在PyTorch 2.6.0中进行了培训,并在装有80GB内存的NVIDIA A100 GPU上进行了培训。

blocks.en: All available longitudinal images from the AREDS development participants were used as separate image-level observations during FAA training. For downstream Cox-model development and evaluation, only baseline qualifying-visit CFPs were used as model inputs.
blocks.zh: 所有来自AREDS开发参与者的可得到的纵向图像在FAA训练中被用作单独的图像级观测. 对于下游的Cox模型开发和评价,仅使用基准合格访问CFP作为模型投入.

blocks.en: After training, FAA for each retained baseline image was calculated by averaging the predictions from five trained FAA models. This ensemble procedure was used for both the AREDS development eyes included in Cox-model fitting and the eyes in the held-out evaluation cohorts. Consequently, the FAA values used for Cox-model development were ensemble predictions, while all values from participants in the AREDS internal-test and AREDS2 cohorts were unseen by every FAA model included in the ensemble during training. Records missing FAA, chronological age, survival time, event status, smoking status, or a phenotype required for the corresponding downstream Cox model were excluded using complete-case analysis, and no imputation was performed.
blocks.zh: 训练后,每个保留基线图像的FAA通过5个训练有素的FAA模型的预测平均值来计算. 这种综艺程序既用于Cox型装配中包含的AREDS开发眼,也用于被搁置的评价组群中的眼. 因此,用于Cox模型开发的FAA值是共通预测,而AREDS内部测试参与者和AREDS2组群的所有值都是在培训期间被列入综艺集的FAA模型所看不到的。 记录缺失的FAA,年龄,存活时间,事件状态,吸烟状态,或相应下游所需的一种苯基. Cox模型不采用完整的案例分析,也没有进行估算。

blocks.en: 4.5.  Statistical analysis
blocks.zh: 4.5. 统计分析

blocks.en: The performance of the survival models was evaluated using the concordance index (C-index), time-dependent area under the receiver-operating-characteristic curve (AUC), and Brier score. The C-index quantified overall discriminative ability, with higher values indicating better concordance between predicted risk and observed progression times. Time-dependent AUCs were evaluated annually from years 2–7 in AREDS and from years 2–5 in AREDS2. Because follow-up duration differed between the two cohorts, the Brier score was evaluated at 5 years in AREDS and at 2 years in AREDS2. Lower Brier scores indicated lower prediction error.
blocks.zh: 使用协调指数(C-index),接收器-操作-特征曲线(AUC)下的时间依赖区和Brier分数来评价存活模型的性能。 C指数量化了整体歧视能力,较高的数值表明预测的风险和观察到的进度时间之间有更好的协调。 每年对AREDS2至7年级和AREDS22至5年级的依赖时间的AUC进行评估。 由于两个组别的后续期限不同,Brier的得分在AREDS中为5年,在AREDS2中为2年. Brier分数较低,表示预测错误较低。

blocks.en: Time-dependent AUCs and Brier scores were estimated using inverse-probability-of-censoring weighting, as implemented by the cumulative_dynamic_auc and brier_score functions in scikit-survival. For held-out evaluation in AREDS and AREDS2, the censoring distribution was estimated from the AREDS development cohort using the Kaplan–Meier estimator. IPCW was used specifically for the time-dependent AUC and Brier score and relied on the independent-censoring assumption.
blocks.zh: 时间依赖的AUC和Brier分数是使用反概率-审查权重来估计的,由scikit-survival的累积-动态-auc和brier-score函数所执行. 对于AREDS和AREDS2的搁置评价,审查发行量是从使用Kaplan-Meier估计器的AREDS开发组中估算出来的。 IPCW被专门用于时间依赖的AUC和Brier分数,并依赖于独立审查的假设.

blocks.en: These median splits were used to visualize relative risk separation within the prespecified population or stratum. They were not optimized clinical decision thresholds and should not be interpreted as universally transportable or directly actionable cutoffs. Group differences in the Kaplan–Meier analyses were assessed using two-sided log-rank tests. Hazard ratios and 95% confidence intervals for the high-versus-low comparisons, where reported, were estimated separately using Cox proportional-hazards models. Accordingly, the displayed log-rank P values were obtained independently of the Cox-model hazard ratios and confidence intervals. blocks.en: The individual-level clinical, phenotypic, and color fundus photograph data analyzed in this study were obtained from the controlled-access National Institutes of Health resources for the Age-Related Eye Disease Study (AREDS) and Age-Related Eye Disease Study 2 (AREDS2). The AREDS data set (NCT00000145) generated during and/or analyzed during the current study is available in the dbGAP repository ( https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/projects/gap/cgi-bin/study.cgi?study_id=phs000001.v3.p1 ). The AREDS2 data set generated during and/or analyzed during the current study has been deposited in dbGAP, accession number phs002015.v1.p1. However, due to an ongoing IRB review of the AREDS2 data set, the data will not be available in dbGAP for ∼ 3 \sim 3 months post-publication. While the AREDS2 data set is being reviewed by the IRB, it is available from the corresponding author upon reasonable request.
blocks.zh: 本研究分析的个人临床、间皮和彩色基金照片数据取自国家卫生研究所用于与年龄有关的眼病研究(AREDS)和与年龄有关的眼病研究2(AREDS2)。 在本次研究期间产生和(或)分析的AREDS数据集(NCT000145)载于dbGAP存储库(https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/projects/gap/cgi-bin/study.cgi?study_id=phs0001001.v3.p1). 本研究期间产生和(或)分析的AREDS2数据集已存入dbGAP,加入号为phs002015.v1.p1. 然而,由于IRB对AREDS2数据集正在进行的审查,在出版后3个月里,数据将无法在dbGAP中提供。 虽然IRB正在审查AREDS2数据集,但应相应作者的合理要求,该数据集可以提供。

blocks.en: Source code for FAA model training and inference, Cox-model development and evaluation, statistical analyses, and figure generation is publicly available through the FundusAge GitHub repository at https://github.com/bionlplab/FundusAge . The analyses were implemented using Python 3.10, PyTorch 2.6.0, Lifelines 0.30.0, scikit-survival 0.23.1, and scikit-learn 1.5.2. The repository does not contain individual-level AREDS or AREDS2 clinical data or color fundus photographs. Researchers seeking to reproduce the analyses must obtain independent authorized access to the source datasets through dbGaP and configure the corresponding local data paths as described in the repository documentation.
blocks.zh: 通过FundusAge GitHub寄存器https://github.com/bionlplab/FundusAge,可公开查阅FAA模型培训和推论、Cox模型开发和评价、统计分析和数字生成的源代码。 使用Python 3.10、PyTorch 2.6.0、生命线0.30.0、scikit-suvival 02.3.1和scikit-learn 1.5.2进行了分析。 该寄存器不包含个人级别的AREDS或AREDS2临床数据或彩色基金照片. 寻求复制分析的研究人员必须通过dbGaP获得对源数据集的独立授权访问,并配置寄存器文件中描述的相应本地数据路径.

blocks.en: B.3.  Harmonization of phenotype variables between AREDS and AREDS2
blocks.zh: B.3. AREDS和AREDS2之间酚型变量的协调

blocks.en: Phenotype harmonization was used specifically for the AREDS2 external-validation analysis. The primary AREDS internal-test Cox models were fitted and evaluated using the native AREDS phenotype coding. For external validation, corresponding variables were mapped to common, variable-specific numerical scales, and the harmonized Cox models were fitted using the recoded AREDS development data before application to AREDS2. No AREDS2 participant-level outcomes were used for model fitting, recalibration, model selection, or threshold determination.
blocks.zh: 专用于AREDS2外部验证分析。 主要AREDS内部测试Cox模型是使用原生AREDS phenotype编码安装和评价的。 对于外部验证,将相应的变量映射到常见的可变具体数字尺度上,统一Cox模型在应用到AREDS2之前使用被重新编码的AREDS开发数据被安装. 没有使用AREDS2参与者一级的成果来进行模型配置、再校正、模型选择或阈值确定。

blocks.en: For the RPEDWI/DPINGRID variable pair, AREDS RPEDWI was coarsened from its native 0–7 scale to the DPINGRID-compatible 0–4 scale using the following mapping: 0 → \rightarrow 0, 1 → \rightarrow 1, 2 → \rightarrow 2, 3–4 → \rightarrow 3, and 5–7 → \rightarrow 4. AREDS2 DPINGRID was already recorded on the corresponding 0–4 scale and was used without further transformation.
blocks.zh: 对于RPEDWI/DPINGRID可变配对,AREDS RPEDWI从原生的0比7比0比7到DPINGRID相容的0比4比0比4比0比0比0比0比0比1比1比1比1比2比2比2比2比3比3比4比5比7比1比1比1比1比1比1比1比1比1比1比1比1比1比1比1比1比1比1比1比1比1比1比1比1比1比1比1比1比1比1比1比1比2比2比2比2比2比3比3比3比4比5比7比7比1比1比1比1比1比1比1比1比1比1比1比1比1比1比1比1比1比1比1比1比1比1比1比1比1比1比1比1比1比1比1比1比1比1比1比1比1比1比1 4. AREDS2 DPINGRID已经记录在相应的0至4尺度上,并且使用时没有进一步转化。

blocks.en: For the INCPWI/IPINGRID variable pair, AREDS INCPWI was coarsened from its native 0–7 scale to the IPINGRID-compatible 0–3 scale using the following mapping: 0 → \rightarrow 0, 1 → \rightarrow 1, 2–4 → \rightarrow 2, and 5–7 → \rightarrow 3. AREDS2 IPINGRID was already recorded on the corresponding 0–3 scale and was used without further transformation.
blocks.zh: 对于INCPWI/IPINGRID可变配对,AREDS INCPWI从原生的0到7相容的IPINGRID相容的0到3相接配对,采用下列绘图法: 0~正中线0, 1~正中线1, 2~4~正中线2和5~7~正中线. 3. AREDS2 IPINGRID已经记录在相应的0至3尺度上,使用时没有作进一步的转换。

blocks.en: For geographic atrophy, the continuous AREDS2 GADAGRID variable, which records geographic-atrophy area in disc areas, was discretized according to the native AREDS GEOAWI thresholds. Values were coded as 0 for absence, 1 when the source annotation explicitly indicated questionable geographic atrophy, 2 for an area greater than 0 and less than 0.058 disc areas, 3 for 0.058 to less than 0.19 disc areas, 4 for 0.19 to less than 0.5 disc areas, 5 for 0.5 to less than 1 disc area, 6 for 1 to less than 2 disc areas, and 7 for 2 or more disc areas. AREDS GEOAWI was retained on its native 0–7 scale.
blocks.zh: 就地缘萎缩而言,连续的AREDS2 GADAGRID变量记录了圆盘地区的地缘萎缩面积,按照本地的AREDS GEOAWI阈值进行了盘状调整。 数值编码为:缺席为0;来源注释明确显示地理萎缩有问题时为1;大于0和小于0.058个圆盘区域为2;0.058至小于0.19个圆盘区域为3;0.19至小于0.5个圆盘区域为4;0.5至小于1个圆盘区域为5;1至小于2个圆盘区域为6;2个或2个以上圆盘区域为7。 AREDS GEOAWI按原产地0至7级保留。

blocks.en: AREDS DRARWI and its AREDS2 counterpart DARINGRD already shared the same 0–7 coding and were used without transformation. Similarly, DRUSENQ/EXAM and PIGDRUQ/PIGAB shared 0–3 and binary coding, respectively.
blocks.zh: AREDS DARWI及其AREDS2对应的DARINGRD已经共享同样的0–7编码,并且没有被转换而使用. 同样,DRUSENQ/EXAM和PIGDRUQ/PIGAB分别共享了0–3和二进制编码.

blocks.en: Accordingly, the primary AREDS internal-test results were obtained using native AREDS phenotype coding, whereas the AREDS2 external-validation results were obtained using harmonized Cox models fitted solely in the AREDS development cohort and subsequently applied to AREDS2.
blocks.zh: 因此,主要AREDS内部测试结果采用本地的AREDS Phenotype编码方式获得,而AREDS2外部验证结果则采用完全安装在AREDS开发组的和谐Cox模型,随后应用于AREDS2。

blocks.en: Appendix C Statistical Analysis
blocks.zh: 附录C 统计 分析

blocks.en: C.1.  Cox Proportional Hazards Models
blocks.zh: C.1. Cox比例危害模型

blocks.en: We constructed Cox proportional hazards models to evaluate the prognostic value of the Fundus-based AMD Age (FAA) and comparison baselines. All models were built using the CoxPH implementation in the Lifelines Python package .
blocks.zh: 我们构建了Cox比例危险模型,以评价基于Fundus的AMD时代的预测值和比较基线. 所有模型都是在生命线Python软件包中使用CoxPH执行来构建的。

blocks.en: For each model, the following covariates were included depending on the phenotype setting:
blocks.zh: 每种型号,根据型号设置,包括下列同位素:

blocks.en: • Reading-center–defined models in AREDS dataset: – FAA (or chronological age, depending on the comparison) – Geographic atrophy within grid (GEOAWI) – RPE depigmentation within grid (RPEDWI) – Increased pigment within grid (INCPWI) – Drusen area within grid (DRARWI) – Smoking status (SMK) • Reading-center–defined models in AREDS2 dataset: – FAA (or chronological age, depending on the comparison) – Geographic atrophy within grid (GEOAWI) – RPE depigmentation within grid (RPEDWI), recode to 0-4 to fit with definition in AREDS2 – Increased pigment within grid (INCPWI), recode to 0-3 to fit with definition in AREDS2 – Drusen area within grid (DRARWI) – Smoking status (SMK) • Specialist-defined models in both AREDS and AREDS2: – FAA (or chronological age) – Clinical drusen size assessment (DRUSENQ) – Pigment abnormalities (PIGDRUQ) – Smoking status (SMK)
blocks.zh: • 阅读中心-AREDS数据集中定义的模型:- FAA(或时间年龄,视比较而定)-网格内的地理萎缩(GEOAWI)-网格内的REPE去皮化(RPEDWI)-网格内的色素增加(INCPWI)-网格内的德鲁森区(DRARWI)-吸烟状态(SMK) 阅读中心-AREDS2数据集中定义的模型:-FAA(或时间年龄,视比较而定)-网格内的地理萎缩(GEOAWI)-网格内的RPE去皮化(RPEDWI),重新编码为0-4,以适应AREDS2的定义(INCPWI)-网格内的德鲁森区(DRUSWI)-吸烟状态(SMK)中专家定义的模型:AREDS(或时间年龄)-网格鲁森区(RUS)-临床的大小评估(NADRUST)

blocks.en: C.2.  Unit of Analysis and Single-Eye Sensitivity Analyses
blocks.zh: C.2. 分析和单眼敏感性分析股

blocks.en: All survival outcomes were defined at the eye level. Each eligible eye contributed a separate analytical record containing an eye-specific baseline color fundus photograph, FAA estimate, AMD phenotype measurements, progression indicator, and follow-up time. A participant could contribute one or two eligible eyes to the primary analyses.
blocks.zh: 所有生存结果都是在眼上确定的。 每一只合格的眼睛都提供了一份单独的分析记录,其中包含一个针对眼睛的基线颜色Fundus相片,FAA估计,AMD的苯基测量,进展指标,以及后续时间. 一位与会者可以为初级分析提供一至两只合格的眼睛。

blocks.en: To directly evaluate whether the primary findings were driven by the inclusion of correlated bilateral observations, we performed strict single-eye sensitivity analyses. Within each phenotype-definition setting, the Cox models were evaluated using only left or only right eyes from the held-out internal-test cohort. Thus, each participant contributed at most one eye . The eligibility criteria, covariate sets, Cox-model specifications, and penalization parameters were identical to those used in the primary analyses with no side-specific model selection or threshold optimization. C-index confidence intervals were estimated using 5,000 bootstrap resamples. Because each participant contributed at most one eye to a given side-specific dataset, these sensitivity analyses did not contain correlated fellow-eye observations.
blocks.zh: 为了直接评估主要结论是否由相关双边观察所驱动,我们进行了严格的单眼敏感性分析。 在每种酚类定义的设定中,考克模型只使用被搁置的内部测试组的左眼或只使用右眼进行评估。 因此,每位与会者最多只能一眼看一眼。 资格标准、共性套件、Cox-model规格和惩罚性参数与初级分析中使用的标准相同,没有附带特定的模型选择或阈值优化。 C-指数置信间隔估计使用5 000个靴子后缀。 由于每个参与者最多都对某个特定侧面数据集贡献一面,这些敏感性分析并不包含相通的同眼观测.

blocks.en: Across all four single-eye analyses, FAA consistently improved the C-index by 0.044 to 0.060 relative to chronological age. While the confidence intervals were wider because of the smaller sample sizes, the improvements were consistent with the primary analyses. These results indicate that the observed benefit of FAA was not driven by the inclusion of correlated bilateral eyes.
blocks.zh: 在所有4个单眼分析中,FAA始终将C指数与时间年龄相比提高了0.044至0.060。 虽然由于样本规模较小,置信间隔较大,但改进与主要分析一致。 这些结果表明,观察到的FAA的好处并非由包含相关双边眼所驱动.

blocks.en: C.3.  Assessment of Cox Proportional-Hazards Assumptions and Covariate Functional Forms
blocks.zh: C.3. 对Cox比例假设和协同功能形式的评估

blocks.en: The following analyses were performed in the AREDS development cohort after the primary Cox-model specifications had been fixed. Separate diagnostic analyses were conducted for the reading-center-defined and specialist-defined models containing either chronological age or fundus-based AMD age (FAA). Within each phenotype-definition setting, the chronological-age-based and FAA-based models used the same complete-case analytical samples and the same smoking and ocular phenotype covariates; only the age representation differed.
blocks.zh: 以下分析是在主要Cox模型规格确定后,在AREDS开发组内进行的。 对阅读中心定义的和专家定义的模型分别进行了诊断分析,这些模型既包括时间年龄,也包括基于资金的AMD年龄。 在每种苯基的定义设置中,基于时间顺序的模型和基于FAA的模型使用相同的完整案例分析样本以及相同的吸烟和显性苯基共变;只有年龄代表不同.

blocks.en: C.3.1.  Proportional-hazards assumption
blocks.zh: C.3.1. 相称风险假设

blocks.en: The proportional-hazards assumption was assessed using scaled Schoenfeld residuals. Covariate-specific tests were performed for each primary Cox model. A two-sided P value below 0.05 was considered evidence against the proportional-hazards assumption. These diagnostics were used to assess the stability of covariate effects over follow-up and were not used for data-driven variable selection.
blocks.zh: 对比例风险假设的评估采用了按比例分摊的Schoenfeld残余物。 对每一种主要的Cox模型都进行了同位素特定测试。 0.05以下的双面P值被认为是与比例风险假设相反的证据。 这些诊断被用于评估同变效应的稳定性而不是后续,没有用于数据驱动的变量选择.

blocks.en: In the reading-center-defined setting, departures from strict linearity were detected for chronological age ( p = 0.034 p=0.034 ) and FAA ( p < 0.001 p<0.001 ). In the specialist-defined setting, no evidence of nonlinearity was observed for chronological age ( p = 0.224 p=0.224 ), whereas a modest nonlinear association was detected for FAA ( p = 0.025 p=0.025 ). However, the spline specifications changed held-out C-indices by no more than 0.005. The FAA-based model retained higher discrimination than the chronological-age-based model under the spline specification in both phenotype-definition settings. The prespecified linear terms were therefore retained in the primary prediction models for parsimony and direct comparability, while the corresponding per-year hazard ratios are interpreted as average log-linear associations over the observed range rather than constant effects at every predictor value.
blocks.zh: 在从读取中心定义的设定中,检测到严格线性在时间上的年龄(p = 0.034 p = 0.034)和FAA(p < 0.001 p < 0.001),在专家定义的设定中,没有观测到时间上年龄的非线性证据(p = 0.224 p = 0.224),而在FAA中检测到一个适度的非线性关联(p = 0.025 p = 0.025),但线性规格改变所持有的C-indices不超过0.005。 基于FAA的模型在两种苯基-定义设置中都保留了比按时间顺序排列的模型更高的区别. 因此,预先确定的线性术语被保留在剖面和直接可比性的主要预测模型中,而相应的每年危险比率被解释为观测范围的平均对数线性关联,而不是每个预测值的常数效应。

blocks.en: C.3.3.  Sensitivity to categorical coding of ordinal phenotype grades
blocks.zh: C.3.3. 绝对编码普通平分等级的敏感性

blocks.en: In the primary models, ordered phenotype grades were entered as linear score terms, such that each hazard ratio represented an average change in log hazard per one-grade increase. To evaluate whether the FAA-versus-chronological-age comparison depended on the assumption of equal risk increments between adjacent grades, the nonbinary phenotype variables were reparametrized as categorical indicator variables. The chronological-age-based and FAA-based models were then refitted using the same complete-case analytical samples, covariates, and penalization parameters. C-index confidence intervals and paired differences were estimated using 5,000 participant-level bootstrap resamples, retaining all eligible eyes from a sampled participant together.
blocks.zh: 在初级模型中,订购的酚类分数被输入为线性分数名词,因此每个危险分数代表每个一等分增加的日志危险的平均变化. 为了评价FAA-与时间-年龄的比较是否取决于相邻职等之间同等风险递增的假设,将非二元酚类变量作为绝对指标变量进行再平衡. 然后使用相同的完整案例分析样本、同分变量和惩罚参数重排基于年龄和FAA的模型。 使用5 000个参与者级靴子重新印章估计了C-index的置信间隔和配对差异,将抽样参与者的所有合格眼睛放在一起。

blocks.en: C.3.4.  Summary of assumption and sensitivity analyses
blocks.zh: C.3.4. 假设和敏感性分析摘要

blocks.en: Overall, the diagnostics showed no clear evidence that the proportional-hazards assumption was violated for chronological age or FAA, although an isolated covariate-specific signal was observed for DRARWI in the reading-center chronological-age model. Restricted cubic splines detected statistically significant nonlinearity in some model settings, but allowing nonlinear age functions changed held-out C-indices by no more than 0.005 and did not alter the higher discrimination of FAA-based models. Likewise, the FAA-associated improvement was retained when ordinal phenotype scores were represented categorically. These analyses support the robustness of the primary FAA-versus-chronological-age comparison while motivating cautious interpretation of single per-year and per-grade hazard ratios as average associations across the observed ranges.
blocks.zh: 总的来说,这些诊断没有显示有明确证据表明,在时间跨度或FAA时,比例危害的假设被违反,不过在读取-中心时间跨度模型中,DARWI观察到了一个孤立的同变量特定信号. 受限制的立方形在有些模型设置中检测出统计上具有显著的非线性,但允许非线性年龄函数改变所持有的C-indice不超过0.005,并没有改变基于FAA的模型的更高分量. 同样,在绝对代表正数的酚类分数时,保留了FAA相关的改进. 这些分析支持了主要FAA与时间-年龄比较的稳健性,同时促使人们谨慎地将每年和每级的单一危险比率解释为观测范围内的平均关联。

blocks.en: C.5.  Adapted image-only benchmark based on Yan et al.
blocks.zh: C.5. 基于Yan等人的可调整的仅图像基准。

blocks.en: To provide a matched image-based benchmark, we adapted the publicly available implementation of Yan et al. 24 The genetic-input branch was removed, and the adapted model used only baseline color fundus photographs as input. The benchmark was trained using the same participant-level AREDS development partition and evaluated using the same eligible AREDS internal-test eyes as the FAA-based analysis. Images from both eyes and all longitudinal visits of each participant were retained within the same data partition. The benchmark predicted progression to late AMD within 5 years from the baseline image. Late AMD was defined as the first AREDS severity score of 10–12. Eyes that progressed to late AMD within 5 years were labeled as events, whereas eyes remaining free of late AMD through 5 years were labeled as non-events. The continuous predicted probability was used as the benchmark risk score for C-index evaluation. No AREDS internal-test participant was used for model training, model selection, or hyperparameter optimization.
blocks.zh: 为了提供匹配的以图像为基础的基准,我们调整了对Yan等人的公开执行。 24 基因输入分支被删除,被修改的模型只使用基线彩色Fundus相片作为输入. 该基准是使用同样的参与者级AREDS开发分区进行训练的,并使用与FAA分析相同的合格AREDS内部测试眼睛进行评价。 每一参与者的眼睛和所有纵向访问的图像都保留在同一数据分区内。 基准预测在5年内从基线图像向晚期AMD发展。 晚期AMD被定义为第一个AREDS重度分数为10–12. 在5年内发展到AMD后期的眼被贴上事件标签,而从AMD后期到5年的眼被贴上非事件标签. 连续预测的概率被用作C-指数评价的基准风险分数。 没有使用AREDS内部测试参与者进行模型培训、模型选择或超参数优化。
